thesis: The site is the job order written in the dirt: every section is one verb in the sequence RAKE · CUT · PULL · SHAKE · TUCK · BLOW, and the bed line drawn down the left margin is the spade cut that holds the whole page together.

signature.name: bed-line
signature.summary: A single hand-cut SVG spade-edge line runs down the left margin (desktop) or top rail (mobile); each process step is a notch cut into it with the verb in condensed caps. Curves into bed shapes for services, becomes the estimator sketch perimeter, stubs beside review Sample tags, and tucks under the footer disclaimer. Hook: data-sw-signature='bed-line'.

palette.family: Wet Bark + Straw Amber + Azalea Edge

motion.intro: Bed line draws top-to-bottom in one stroke as hero loads; loose needles settle along it via staggered opacity. ≤1.2s, skippable, text readable from frame 0.
stories: Process: six steps pinned ≥640px; each photo unclips while line cuts to next notch. Height calc(6*55svh+100svh). Mobile: stacked cards with clip reveal.
Slope check: bed line curves into slope profile; reshapes on input; tuck-depth marker slides. Not pinned.
motion.hover: Signal-pink hairline grows from left via scaleX(0→1), 200ms, @media (hover:hover) only.
